svg.title: Reasoning prompts trade more tokens for more accuracy
svg.desc: Direct answering, chain-of-thought, self-consistency, tree search, and graph search spend increasing tokens or search to improve answers. Program-aided language models translate a calculation to code and use an interpreter for exact arithmetic.

g.text: Reasoning prompts trade more tokens for more accuracy
Use steps, voting, search, or code—then prefer answers you can verify.
More generated steps and search can help—but some gains come from recalling familiar patterns.
PAL · LET AN INTERPRETER DO THE EXACT ARITHMETIC
